earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 a4ex991-pressreleaseq127.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 WD Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results Q1FY27 Highlights: • Revenue of $4.38 billion, up 55% year-over-year • GAAP gross margin of 57.8%; non-GAAP gross margin of 58.1% • GAAP diluted EPS of $4.63; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.64 • Cash flow from operations of $1.60 billion; free cash flow of $1.38 billion • Q2FY27 revenue expected to be up 66% to 72% year-over-year SAN JOSE, Calif. — October 22, 2026 — Western Digital Corporation (Nasdaq: WDC) today reported fiscal first quarter 2027 financial results for the period ended October 2, 2026. “Fiscal 2027 is off to a strong start, with results exceeding expectations, driven by robust customer demand and disciplined execution. In our fiscal first quarter, revenue grew 55% year over year, non-GAAP gross and operating margins expanded to 58.1% and 49.1%, respectively, resulting in a 161% year-over-year increase in non-GAAP EPS. Reflecting our confidence in the business and our commitment to return capital to shareholders, we are raising our quarterly cash dividend by 17% to $0.175 per share,” said Irving Tan, CEO of WD. “We are executing well through our technology transitions to meet the growing demand for storage. As we deepen our customer relationships, broaden the customer base to new areas of the market, and extend our visibility into future demand, we are building an increasingly durable foundation for long-term value creation.” 1 Western Digital Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results Q1FY27 Financial Highlights ($ in millions, except per share amounts) GAAP Q1FY27 Q4FY26 Q1FY26 Q/Q Y/Y Revenue $4,381 $3,747 $2,818 +17% +55% Gross Margin 57.8% 54.1% 43.5% +370 bps +1430 bps Operating Income $2,046 $1,563 $792 +31% +158% Operating Margin 46.7% 41.7% 28.1% +500 bps +1860 bps Diluted Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders $1,779 $3,195 $1,154 -44% +54% Diluted Net Income Per Common Share $4.63 $8.21 $3.07 -44% +51% Non-GAAP Q1FY27 Q4FY26 Q1FY26 Q/Q Y/Y Revenue $4,381 $3,747 $2,818 +17% +55% Gross Margin 58.1% 54.4% 43.9% +370 bps +1420 bps Operating Income $2,153 $1,655 $856 +30% +152% Operating Margin 49.1% 44.2% 30.4% +490 bps +1870 bps Diluted Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders $1,779 $1,382 $655 +29% +172% Diluted Net Income Per Common Share $4.64 $3.56 $1.78 +30% +161% 2 Western Digital Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results Business Outlook for Fiscal Second Quarter of 2027 “Our first quarter results demonstrate the continued momentum in our business, with robust exabyte growth and improved pricing driving another quarter of strong financial performance,” said Kris Sennesael, CFO of WD. “Looking ahead, for our fiscal second quarter of 2027, at the midpoint of the ranges, we expect revenue of $5.1 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 60.5%, and non-GAAP EPS of $5.80.” Non-GAAP (1) Revenue $5.1B +/- $100M Gross margin 60% - 61% Operating expenses $400M - $410M Interest and other expense, net ~ $15M Tax rate ~ 17% Diluted net income per common share $5.80 +/- $0.20 Diluted weighted average shares ~ 380M (1) We provide earnings guidance only on a non-GAAP basis because certain information necessary to reconcile such guidance to GAAP is difficult to estimate or cannot be allocated or quantified with certainty and is dependent on future events outside of our control. Please refer to the section titled “Non-GAAP Guidance” under “Discussion Regarding the Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures” in this press release for additional information regarding the non-GAAP measures, including quantification of known expected adjustment items. Dividend WD’s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.175 per share of the company’s common stock, which will be paid on December 17, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on December 4, 2026. WD’s Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Conference Call WD will host a conference call to discuss its fiscal first quarter 2027 results and business outlook for the fiscal second quarter of 2027 today at 1:30 p.m. Pacific / 4:30 p.m. Eastern. The live and archived conference call and the earnings presentation can be accessed online at investor.wdc.com . About WD WD, also known as Western Digital, builds the storage infrastructure that powers certainty in the AI-driven data economy. At the forefront of innovation, WD partners with the world’s leading hyperscalers, cloud service providers, and enterprises to enable reliable storage solutions that are proven and trusted at scale. Driven by a culture of innovation and execution, WD helps customers store, protect, and use the world’s data with confidence.
